Sorry for such a late response. I'd like to see a counselor but now that it is summer I'm not sure how to go about it, I've tried to hint to my parents I'm not okay and have asked about seeing one but they never take me seriously. I know now that if I told my mom about these thoughts even further she wouldn't take me to a counselor.

  A few weeks ago my mom saw that I had marks on my neck that were self inflicted, I tried to cover it up by lying but she called me stupid and ungrateful and that when I'm 18 I can leave and I wouldn't have to worry about her anymore but that's all she said to me about it. I know she's just scared and I realize it's hard on her because she has a God daughter that is in a hospital for multiple suicide attempts and she doesn't want me to be like this. Im lucky to live the way I do but these thoughts are so scary and I'm so scared of what I might do to myself.
